named_question: Can omitted native CID0 safely select the role-independent mix branch without inserting an identity?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Common type5 integer conversion reads the cleared/current string, calls decimal parser and stores its signed32 result.

reused_contract.fact: CID12..19 alone enters the recovered graph/role-forced mix path; supported CID0 on SID1..31 is role-independent. This extends only the previous explicit-CID CLI subset.

source_contract.missing: CID binding uses numeric type5 and param7=0. Reader clears the temporary string before optional attribute lookup; empty decimal conversion returns its initialized0. Constructor also initializes CID0.
source_contract.role_boundary: Omission therefore enters the recovered CID0 branch, not an unknown role mask. The source does not justify defaulting unsupported explicit input or extending CID12..19.
source_contract.storage: The CLI leaves absent CID absent. It changes only selected MixMod when requested; no CID identity is inserted or rewritten.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-mix FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME (--mix | --no-mix)
CLI_policy.new_input: Omitted CID is admitted as effective0. Keep selected unique SID1..31, supported direct sibling SIDs, canonical-or-omitted MixMod and CID12..19 role exclusion.
CLI_policy.unsupported: Present malformed, negative or overflowing CID is rejected before mutation, including requested no-op. No truncation or success-shaped fallback.
CLI_policy.result: Identity retains raw mood.cid null and JSON adds cid_effective0. Existing explicit CID output, CSV column order and scope are unchanged.
CLI_policy.preservation: No CID insertion on change/no-op, no MixMod insertion when both CID/MixMod omitted and false requested, and no unrelated attributes/records/IDs/Qn/flags/counts/references/HCL/sequence/default normalization.
